statement: Full profinite closed-surface recognition fails: a torsion-free index-two extension of the completed closed genus-two group has H^2(E,F3)=F3 and H^2(E,F5)=0, hence is the completion of no surface group. Its exact maximal pro-p quotients are the nonorientable genus-three pro-2 group, Z3^2 at p=3, and free pro-p rank two at every other odd prime.

notes: The proof defines the automorphism directly on the standard closed-surface presentation, avoiding any assumption about efficiency of a profinite amalgam. A full profinite Galois automorphism of a punctured elliptic curve with prescribed cyclotomic multiplier is paired with its actual inverse. The pro-2 quotient detects quotient parity and excludes all torsion. The orientation multiplier is proved by the finite Heisenberg determinant identity and the natural completed intersection pairing. The conjugacy-invariant mixed orientation character also proves that its discretization and prediscretization fixed sets are empty.
